name: 46998-prefillheavy-35ba3bfp8-2gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-FP8 -- 37.46 GB of fp8 block-quantized safetensors across 14 shards, served on two cards.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine (guidellm `vllm_python`), no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration, served text-only: 40-layer hybrid text stack (30 linear-attention, 10 full-attention), hidden 2048, 256 experts with 8 routed per token, fp8 weights over bfloat16 activations, fp32 recurrent state. Full details in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 10% and cooldown 10%, bounded at 1000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, fixed shape: exactly 1024 prompt tokens and exactly 128 output tokens, min = max on both, no shared prefix, seed static 42. Prefill-heavy by construction -- nine prompt tokens enter for every token generated.
purpose: A document summarizer condensing page-long inputs into short briefs for 32 concurrent users on two GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line. The interpreter and the hardware seal are in env.yaml.

model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-FP8

# The checkpoint carries a vision tower; this item serves text only and every modality limit is 0.
language-model-only: true

tensor-parallel-size: 2

# Pinned rather than left to a default: this setup drives the engine in-process
# (guidellm `vllm_python`), a usage context the per-device default table does not cover.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

max-num-seqs: 128
max-model-len: 4096

# 0.75, not the 0.90 default, and the reason is the fleet rather than the model. vLLM turns this
# into a HARD ADMISSION GATE before it allocates anything: `request_memory` raises unless free
# memory at startup is at least `utilization x 79.19 GiB` on EVERY card the run is given. At 0.90
# that is 71.27 GiB, and on 2026-08-23 four attempts across two nodes died with
# `Free memory on device cuda:1 (66.21/79.19 GiB) ... less than desired (0.9, 71.27 GiB)` --
# residue a scoped reap had already declared clean. 0.75 is 59.4 GiB and clears that reading.
#
# It costs the run nothing, because nothing here is sized by it. Per card: 18.73 GiB of weights
# (37.46 GB over TP=2), a few GiB of activations and captured graphs, and a paging pool that must
# hold, at 128 max sequences, ~4 GiB of GDN recurrent state (30 linear layers x 32 v-heads x
# 128 x 128 x fp32, halved by TP) plus the full-attention KV, which at 1 KV head per card x 256
# head_dim x 2 x 2 B x 10 layers is ~10 KiB per token -- 378 MB for the 32 x 1152 tokens this
# closed loop ever has resident. 0.75 leaves ~35 GiB for a working set under 5 GiB, so the
# scheduler never queues, never preempts and never recomputes at either value.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.75
